verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's core product model is task delegation to AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Bedrock-backed Claude) via 'sessions', with workflow modes (Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented, Freeform) and automation runs from CI/cron, directly matching 'delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant'. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the delegation experience beyond vendor docs, and clarity on how autonomous vs supervised the assistant is in practice.
